Iran Plotting Gulf Leaders' Assassinations? Iranian Lawmaker Issues Chilling Threat
results.description: Iran's confrontation with the United States and Israel could be taking a dangerous new turn. An Iranian parliamentarian has reportedly called for the leaders of Gulf Arab states hosting U.S. military bases to be considered targets for revenge, naming the ruling families of Saudi Arabia, the United Arab Emirates and Bahrain alongside American and Israeli officials. Amirhossein Sabeti also accused these Gulf states of having a role in the reported assassination of Iran's former Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei, while claiming that senior Iranian officials had apologised to Arab countries after U.S. military bases were targeted.

results.title: Australian regional leader to visit India; trade, investment ties in focus
results.description: Australian regional leader Chris Minns will lead an official delegation to India later this month seeking to strengthen his state's economic, education and cultural ties with one of its key international partners, according to an official statement on Sunday. New South Wales Premier Minns will undertake an official visit to New Delhi and Mumbai from August 31 to September 3, his office said. New South Wales (NSW) is Australia's most populous state and is home to Sydney, the country's largest city and a major financial, business and education hub. In 2024-25, NSW and India traded goods worth AUD 6.87 billion (USD 4.86 billion), making India one of the state's "most important trading partners", the statement said. "I'm proud that my first overseas visit as Premier will be to India. It reflects the importance of the relationship and the enormous contribution the Indian community makes to NSW," Minns said. The government formed TG SAFE by merging the Food Safety Department and the Drugs Control Administration.

Mohanty to hold TG SAFE charge alongside existing duties

Mohanty currently serves as director general of the Drugs Control Administration. He will take charge as TG SAFE commissioner in addition to his existing responsibilities. The new authority will bring food safety and drug control under a unified administration. The government aims to strengthen regulation and provide more efficient services to the public.
